title.narrative: Resilient Multifunctional Water Supply systems for Machubo Administrative Post - Marracuene District

description.narrative: The Resilient Multifunctional Water Supply Systems for the Machubo Administrative Post project aims to improve water access, sanitation, and climate resilience in Marracuene District, Mozambique. Implemented by UNDP in collaboration with the Ministry of Public Works, Housing, and Water Resources, this one-year initiative (2024-2025) is funded by the IBSA Fund. The project will increase water security, improve livelihoods, and promote climate resilience in Machubo, ensuring better health, education, and economic opportunities for local communities, with a special focus on vulnerable groups like women, children, and persons with disabilities.

condition.narrative: Social and environmental sustainability will be enhanced through application of the UNDP Social and Environmental Standards (http://www.undp.org/ses) and related Accountability Mechanism (http://www.undp.org/secu-srm).

The Implementing Partner shall ensure that all of its obligations set forth under the section entitled “Legal Context and/or Risk Management Standard Clauses” are passed on to each responsible party, subcontractor and sub-recipient and that all the clauses under this section entitled “Risk Management” are included, mutatis mutandis, in all sub-contracts or sub-agreements entered into further to the Project Document
